summary: Scope: source contract for issue1032, not an executed full image or invocation authority. The dispatch-only hosted image route uses the existing closed bar-headless controller and exact accepted FSBar recipe, full internal Git histories, fresh empty operation stores and the corrected private pivot-root entry. Its90-minute outer job must retain the unchanged3600-second work plus120-second retirement aperture and20-minute bounded receipt/transport allowance; neither source preparation nor an intermediate toolchain stage renews the clock or closes the full image promise. The workflow seals actual host OpenSSL/loader/library identities, one original monotonic deadline and a reviewed public recipient before image effects. The controller topology/input binds that seal. Only a verified complete candidate may be encrypted with maintained CMS AuthEnvelopedData AES256GCM and RSAOAEP SHA256/MGF1SHA256; streaming uses BER despite the DER CLI option. The private key never enters source, runner or artifacts. Public Actions artifacts retain encrypted candidate bytes and bounded nonsecret metadata; private operator decryption, digest and bounded OCI readback remain separately selected acceptance. Wrong-key/tamper behavior is checked only on authored tiny synthetic bytes. Full build time/output/VFS disk fit, actual image/static-ELF/load/readback, scoped retirement and unavailable provider disposal evidence retain their distinct native obligations. Old failed preflights and Home holds are not retired by this source route. Loaded ABI, Count1, useful play, B2 adoption and publication remain separate. Source review repaired explicit uid1001/private provisioning for both fixed transport parents. Candidate-only manifest/archive/seal/headroom/encryption refusals preserve independently validated bounded controller metadata and raw streams while denying candidate transport; unsafe metadata still refuses. The runner intentionally opens the delegated unit stdout/stderr evidence files. A command-scoped ShellCheckSC2024 annotation documents that boundary without changing file ownership; the exact shell capture behavior is covered by inert success/failure controls. First full generation40012729113/a1 admitted its own domain but refused checkout-created local gc.auto=0 before product image effects; that original remains failed. The fixed two-checkout bootstrap now requires the exact singleton0/provenance and clean complete internal Git, removes only that local key, verifies other configuration bytes unchanged and invokes the original strict source-identity guard. Missing/duplicate/nonzero/unexpected settings refuse without normalization; global/system configuration and credentials remain untouched. No fresh generation, full image or stronger descendant/provider retirement is established by this source correction. A later original full attempt passed checkout canonicalization/domain admission but refused the shared Buildah info --format=json command before image work. The pinned Buildah1.43.1 CLI defaults to JSON and accepts only a Go template for --format; Podman6.1.4 defaults to YAML and supports explicit json. The shared controller now selects info argv by closed role and retains its existing JSON/store/rootless/platform/source/support/resource/retirement guards. Pure controls reject the original argv with exit125, preserve direct-child EOF and first cause while keeping descendant settlement unproved, and exercise both actual profile preflights plus malformed/wrong-store/rootless/platform/version refusals. Reusable lesson: support-byte/domain probes do not qualify the actual controller CLI protocol; derive fake ports from immutable upstream contracts and audit the remaining closed argv before another costly original attempt. A bounded primary definition audit found no additional substantiated flag/format mismatch; actual native backend/network/response semantics, full content/image/time/disk fit, private readback and retirement remain unqualified. The original failed attempt and its artifacts remain authoritative failures; no source fix or child EOF proves whole-descendant settlement or provider disposal. Pure-check lesson: semantic test success and conformity to the selected command horizon are separate findings. Enforce an admitted wall limit as wall time, rather than confusing it with a CPU limit; size focused source checks using observed suite duration, retain an actual overrun, and do not repeat a whole suite merely to conceal that nonconformance.
